cues: Morality, art, spirituality and creativity are universal human abilities, embedded, he says, in our DNA: his vivid way of saying they are part of being human.
They were born in Stone Age Africa, and they belong to everyone.
To place their origin in China in the age of the Yellow Emperor, or Greece in the age of Plato, or Arabia in the age of Muhammad, is crass egotism.
